curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: II 1,4,[5],12,[27]:b:[e,n,x]. Panel notes: This predicted serotype is not in the Kauffman-White scheme.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR12277900 && mv data/SRR12277900_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR12277900_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: II 1,4,[5],12,[27]:b:[e,n,x]. Antigenic formula should match 4:b:-.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST8013. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. This predicted serotype is not in the Kauffman-White scheme.
